items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: We started playing Coltrane and Hank Mobley, and you know, getting into transcriptions.

ctx.x: Well was there a point, actually two points I’m going to ask about, that you thought oh I’d like to do this for a living, and then, but I have to go somewhere else to do this for a living?

So I could see doing this as a living, the light bulb moment that was the end of high school, and so then I went to audition for the conservatory of the music, which was the jazz, THE jazz course in Sydney. And the first year out of school I didn’t get in because I didn’t really know what I was doing, you know I think I kind of played a blues or something and I didn’t pass the audition because it was a very small intake and it was very competitive, and you know there’s a lot of great musicians. So I didn’t get in…
Did you know other Australian musicians who had done the same think, like Lisa and Nicki Parrott? And did that have advice for you?
